newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products - gas oil slides, fuel holds.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - gas oil slides, fuel holds.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Friday, with some markets falling sharply with last night's sell-off on crude and others holding their ground, traders said.
Gasoline, which fell $4.00 per tonne on Thursday, was about $1.00 weaker around $220 for November swaps.
IPE gas oil fell $6.00 per tonne, but a holiday in Germany meant physical markets were quiet. Heating oil premiums were notionally steady at Nov +$1 fob ARA for prompt barges.
Fuel oil was hardly affected by the rest of the market, with high sulphur barges offered at $119 fob ARA, just $1 below Thursday.
